GenAiPlugin.description: Handles returns, exchanges, refunds and money-back requests for delivered orders.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Check eligibility before creating a return. Only call Issue_Refund for amounts of 100 USD or less after eligibility is confirmed.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to start returns, check return eligibility and create refund cases. Refunds above 100 USD must be created as a case for human approval, never issued directly.
